jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Analyst / Developer Mainframe (Cobol / PL1)
jobs.description:
Ready to take ownership of complex systems and contribute to meaningful digital transformation?

We're looking for an experienced Mainframe Analyst Developer who enjoys designing reliable, scalable solutions and ensuring the continuity of critical applications that serve thousands of users every day.

This is an opportunity to join a human-centered organization where your expertise is valued, your ideas make a difference, and your work-life balance truly matters.
🎯 Your role

As a key member of our development team, you will:

• Lead the technical analysis, design, development, and maintenance of core business applications

• Work on multiple layers - from business logic to system integration and user interfaces

• Translate functional needs into robust, long-term technical solutions

• Ensure the stability, performance, and quality of existing systems while contributing to modernization initiatives

• Collaborate closely with internal teams and act as a technical reference for less experienced developers

• Document and communicate your work clearly to both technical and business stakeholders

💡 What defines you

• You're results-oriented and motivated by technical excellence.

• You value quality, precision, and structured work.

• You're autonomous but thrive in a collaborative environment.

• You take initiative and enjoy improving processes and solutions.

• You communicate clearly and enjoy being a trusted technical advisor.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of experience in software development, ideally with Mainframe systems

• Proficient in procedural programming languages such as C, Cobol, or PL/1

• Solid understanding of relational databases (SQL, DB2, etc.)

• Languages:

• 

• Strong written and spoken command of French and/or Dutch

• Good working knowledge of technical English

 

Additional assets:

• Experience with z/OS, PL/1, CICS, JCL, SOA/ESB, TWS, Web Services, or Java.

• Knowledge of accounting principles or financial applications.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a focus on system reliability and performance.

As a Technical Buyer, you will play a crucial role in driving procurement performance across long-term projects. Your primary focus will be identifying and realizing savings opportunities while building strong, strategic relationships with suppliers. You will challenge cost increases, perform market analyses, develop compelling business cases, and negotiate optimal commercial conditions.

Our client is an international supply chain specialist serving the automotive industry. The company manages the procurement and distribution of fastening solutions and technical components for leading manufacturers worldwide.

This position combines analytical problem-solving with stakeholder management and requires someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and market conditions continuously evolve.

Key Responsibilities

• Analyze supplier price increase requests and assess their impact on procurement budgets.
• Conduct market research and benchmarking to validate pricing proposals and identify cost-saving opportunities.
• Develop and present fact-based business cases to support negotiations and purchasing decisions.
• Lead commercial discussions with suppliers and negotiate the best possible pricing and contractual conditions.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing suppliers.
• Organize and participate in supplier performance reviews and business meetings.
• Monitor market trends and proactively identify risks and opportunities within the supply chain.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive procurement efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Manage purchasing activities for strategic, long-term projects from analysis through implementation.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Business, Supply Chain, Economics, Engineering or a related field.
• 2 to 5 years of experience in purchasing, sourcing, procurement or a comparable commercial role.
• Proven experience in supplier negotiations and achieving measurable cost reductions.
• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills.
• Commercially driven with the confidence to challenge suppliers and defend your position using facts and data.
• Experience within a technical, manufacturing or automotive-related environment is considered a strong advantage.
• Familiarity with procurement terminology, sourcing methodologies and supplier management processes.
• Fluency in English; knowledge of Dutch is an asset.

Coordinate foundry orders and logistics so semiconductor projects move accurately and efficiently from reservation to delivery.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

Are you passionate about technology?
 

Are you interested in supporting a world-class team of engineers?
 

Would you like to help customers innovate and optimize their timelines?
 

The world of chip manufacturing is an interesting and diverse environment. Our enthusiastic and diverse team collaborates with imec’s customers to make their projects become reality. We are eager to welcome new team members to step into this magnificent world and get familiar with the processes of manufacturing chips.
 

Imec.IC-link helps customers design chips and bring them to the prototype and the mass production stage at top chip foundries. Imec is a qualified TSMC Value Chain Alliance partner and offers state-of-the-art prototype and volume fabrication services to fabless companies and system houses. Imec.IC link provides its customers with specialized technical solutions for the design prototyping, and mass production of chips.
 

As a Fulfilment Operations Officer, you act as a key link between customers, suppliers, manufacturing partners, and internal teams. You ensure that operational activities run smoothly by coordinating orders, deliveries, documentation, and logistics processes from start to finish. You monitor progress, maintain accurate information in the relevant systems, and proactively address issues to ensure customer commitments are met.
 

Your key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Coordinating operational activities with customers, suppliers, manufacturing partners, and internal stakeholders. 

• Ensuring orders, requests, and related information are complete, accurate, and processed on time. 

• Supporting production planning and capacity allocation activities. 

• Managing the flow of products, materials, and deliveries throughout the supply chain. 

• Maintaining accurate operational data and visibility in the relevant systems and tools. 

• Preparing and reviewing required logistics, shipping, and compliance documentation. 

• Monitoring operational performance and following up on open actions and exceptions. 

• Investigating and resolving day-to-day issues related to orders, deliveries, logistics, invoicing, and other operational processes. 

• Driving effective communication across stakeholders to ensure timely and successful execution of customer projects. 

Who you are
 

Helping people makes you happy!
 
 

• You enjoy bringing structure to complex operational work and helping customers and colleagues move projects forward. 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree or have equivalent relevant experience in logistics, operations, supply chain, business support or a related field. 

• You communicate clearly in English, both verbally and in writing, and are comfortable working with international customers and suppliers. 

• You are customer-focused, accurate and organised, and you can manage several open actions and deadlines at the same time. 

• You take initiative, investigate inconsistencies and coordinate with the right owners rather than letting operational issues remain unresolved. 

• You are eager to learn about semiconductor manufacturing and foundry operations. Prior semiconductor experience is an asset, not a requirement. 

• You are comfortable learning and using business systems. Experience with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or other similar systems is an asset.

Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.
• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).
• Start up and optimize production lines.
• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.
• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.
Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.
 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.
• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.
• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.
• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.
• Fluency in Dutch or English.

Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés. Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.Safran Aircraft Engines conçoit, produit et commercialise, seul ou en coopération, des moteurs aéronautiques civils et militaires aux meilleurs niveaux de performance, fiabilité et respect de l'environnement. La société est notamment, à travers CFM International*, le leader mondial de la propulsion d'avions commerciaux courts et moyen-courriers.* CFM International est une société commune 50/50 de Safran Aircraft Engines et GE Aerospace.Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.

We're hiring an Operations Shift Manager to reinforce and support our Operations teams. Your role:

• You are a natural leader, guiding and inspiring a multidisciplinary team to successfully deliver the production plan.
• You make things happen, turning weekly planning into a clear daily schedule and deploying the right people and resources to get the job done.
• As a coach and motivator, you ensure flawless execution, support your team's growth, and directly impact the success of our operations.
• In this role you report to the Operations Manager and Operations Director.

Your profile:

• You are both a leader and a team player, able to inspire while collaborating with others.
• You bring expertise, holding a Bachelor or Master in Electromechanics with 3-5 years of relevant experience in an industrial environment.
• You have strong people management skills and the drive to take on new challenges with confidence.
• You are analytical and resilient, thriving under pressure and keeping a sharp focus on deadlines.
• You are communicative and fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You are flexible, ready to work in shifts (Monday to Friday: 6am-2pm, 2pm-10pm).
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.As part of our growth (RAMP UP) of LEAP engines, we are looking for a CNC Operator to strengthen our teams.

As experienced CNC machine operator, you will oversee our computer numeric controlled (CNC) machines. You will be responsible for ensuring machining of subassembly, quality parts and tools specific to engineering drawings dimensions.

Your Role:

• Set up and operate CNC machines to perform various tasks, including drilling, grinding, and milling.
• Ensure CNC machines operate in compliance with company guidelines and safety standards.
• Monitor machines during operation and make necessary adjustments to optimize results.
• Inspect machinery daily to ensure proper functionality.
• Record all machine activities by completing production and quality logs.
• Provide accurate timelines and updates to clients.
• Communicate with the Methods Department regarding any issues encountered during machining.
• Ensure that machining results meet the defined work scope and quality expectations.
• Conduct regular assessments and maintenance of CNC machines.

Your Profile:

• High school diploma or equivalent qualification required.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience as a CNC machine operator.
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical documents and engineering drawings.
• Strong mechanical aptitude.
• Excellent attention to detail and a goal-oriented attitude.
• Strong comprehension and analytical skills.
• Knowledge of the latest equipment and techniques in the industry.
• Good computer skills.
• You have a very knowledge of technical English and a basic understanding of Dutch or French, with the desire to improve it.
• Willingness to work in a 3-shift system
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
